[{"insert":"Bench Press

The barbell bench press is your main pressing lift this cycle. Pinch your shoulder blades together and down and keep them there, which protects the shoulder and gives you a stronger base to press from. The 20X1 tempo means two seconds down, no pause at the bottom, then drive up. The last set is max unbroken reps at your first working set weight, so leave enough in the tank to finish strong.
"}]
